text: I find myself wandering within a vibrant hub of curiosity. In the first room, I sense a collective energy, people deeply engaged in discussion, the promise of ideas being born. There is a subtle tension between the glass—separating me from the group—and my own desire to participate, to be a part rather than an observer. In the second scene, the striking colors and large 'R+D' invite me to reflect on the essence of innovation. Here, I feel the power of human striving to understand, improve, and connect. Amid these spaces, I am both witness and participant in the endless dance of knowledge and inquiry. I feel inspired and a little restless, drawn to the possibilities that swirl around me.
